title: Smallest |S| for ε>0 in general metrics not characterized (completeness)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The problem asks to CHARACTERIZE the smallest $|S|$ as a function of $T$, geometry, and $\varepsilon$. The solution characterizes it for $\varepsilon=0$ in $\mathbb R^m$ ($|\partial T|$) and for training-faithful condensation ($k^\star(T)$ = Set Cover optimum), but for $\varepsilon>0$ in general metrics it gives only SUFFICIENT sizes.

**Gap (completeness).** A matching characterization for $\varepsilon>0$ in general metrics — plausibly a PARTIAL set cover / $\varepsilon$-net of the margin region, with matching lower bounds (packing / VC / compression lower bound) — is open and is likely the research core of the problem.
